- Stakeholders you mentioned on the call: product/ops for buy-in, security for technical review, procurement/legal for contract.

As requested, we can provide the following evidence for your security and procurement review:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Penetration test summary and remediation notes

- Answers to any specific questionnaire you send (we can also fill your PDF/Google form)

Can you confirm the exact list of stakeholders and the procurement timeline? Also let us know the preferred secure transfer method (HubSpot secure file, DocuSign, shared drive link, or S3 presigned).

2) Dylan will prepare audit-log samples and retention answers
3) You confirm procurement timeline and any PO/contract redline contacts

Looking to deliver the bulk of docs by EOD Monday (Dec 7) so your review team has time before the week of Dec 12.

Rahul / Ben - attaching a redacted audit log sample and our data retention policy summary. Key points:

- Audit logs: include timestamp, request_id, model_id, user_agent (redacted), action, response_latency_ms, and outcome codes. PII fields are not captured in logs by default; any user identifiers are hashed.
- Retention: short-term hot storage for 90 days, archived encrypted backups for 2 years, access controlled via RBAC and logged.
- Delivery: AuditLogs_Sample.csv (redacted) and Data_Retention_Policy.pdf attached in the secure folder referenced by Marissa.
